_why: Starter lists for scripts/lib/cn-model-dispatch-gate.js (Fleet task 01M7E2A1, card d-1dfcf757). A repo extends every list (union, never replaces) in .claude/cn-model-gate.json, including review_roles. review_local_exceptions is not one of those lists: only this shipped file counts, because the window is the operator's decision (d-ede04b92, PM 01M7JPZQ), not a repo's. A repo cannot add, extend, or shrink an entry. Globs: `*` stays inside one path segment, `**` crosses directories, a glob without `/` matches any single path segment.
